title: Mailbox/query args
description: Arguments for Mailbox/query (RFC 8621 §3.3). Returns an ordered list of Mailbox ids matching a filter.

accountId.description: The account to query mailboxes from.

filter.description: Filter conditions. Supported properties: parentId (MailboxId|null), name (String), role (String|null), hasAnyRole (Boolean), isSubscribed (Boolean).

sort.description: Sort criteria. Each Comparator has a property (e.g. name, sortOrder) and optional isAscending (default true).

sortAsTree.description: If true, the results are sorted as a tree by parentId: a Mailbox that is an ancestor of another comes first, and siblings are sorted by the sort comparators (default false; RFC 8621 section 2.3).

filterAsTree.description: If true, a Mailbox is included only if all its ancestors are also included by the filter (default false; RFC 8621 section 2.3).

position.description: Zero-based index of the first id to return. A negative value is an offset from the end of the list (RFC 8620 section 5.5). Ignored when anchor is given.

anchor.description: An id. When given, position is ignored and the first id returned is at the index of this id in the results plus anchorOffset, clamped to 0; an id that is not in the results is the error anchorNotFound (RFC 8620 section 5.5).

anchorOffset.description: Index of the first id to return relative to the index of the anchor; may be negative. Ignored without an anchor.

limit.description: Maximum number of ids to return.

calculateTotal.description: If true, return the total number of matching mailboxes.
